001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.parsers.exception.InvalidTypeException;
004import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigLoadException;
005import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.exception.ConfigNotLoadedException;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
009
010/**
011 * An abstract class that all structured configs extend from
012 * <p>
013 * Contains all the logic for getting/setting values
014 *
015 * @param <T> The type of the data being stored
016 *
017 * @version 5.1.0
018 * @since 1.0.0
019 */
020public abstract class StructuredConfig<T> {
021    /**
022     * The class of the data being stored
023     *
024     * @since 1.0.0
025     */
026    protected final @NotNull Class<T> clazz;
027
028    /**
029     * The data being stored
030     *
031     * @since 1.0.0
032     */
033    protected @Nullable T config = null;
034
035    /**
036     * Create a new Config
037     *
038     * @param clazz The class of the data being stored
039     *
040     * @since 2.0.0
041     */
042    protected StructuredConfig(@NotNull Class<T> clazz) {
043        this(clazz, false);
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Create a new Config
048     *
049     * @param clazz          The class of the data being stored
050     * @param supportsArrays If the config supports storing arrays
051     *
052     * @since 5.0.0
053     */
054    protected StructuredConfig(@NotNull Class<T> clazz, boolean supportsArrays) {
055        if (clazz.isInterface() || clazz.isEnum() || clazz == String.class || clazz == Byte.class || clazz == Character.class || clazz == Short.class || clazz == Integer.class || clazz == Long.class || clazz == Float.class || clazz == Double.class || clazz == Boolean.class) {
056            throw new InvalidTypeException(clazz);
057        }
058        if (clazz.isArray() && !supportsArrays) {
059            throw new InvalidTypeException(clazz);
060        }
061
062        this.clazz = clazz;
063    }
064
065    /**
066     * Get the data being store and loads it if necessary
067     *
068     * @return The data being stored
069     *
070     * @since 1.0.0
071     */
072    public @NotNull T get() {
073        if (!this.getLoaded()) {
074            try {
075                this.load();
076            } catch (IOException e) {
077                throw new ConfigLoadException(e);
078            }
079        }
080
081        if (this.config == null) {
082            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
083        }
084
085        return this.config;
086    }
087
088    /**
089     * Get the data being stored
090     *
091     * @return The data being stored or null
092     *
093     * @since 3.5.0
094     */
095    public @Nullable T getCached() {
096        if (this.config == null) {
097            throw new ConfigNotLoadedException();
098        }
099
100        return this.config;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * Set the data being stored
105     *
106     * @param value The data to be stored
107     *
108     * @since 1.0.0
109     */
110    public void set(@NotNull T value) {
111        this.config = value;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * Get if the config is loaded
116     *
117     * @return If the config is loaded
118     *
119     * @since 1.0.0
120     */
121    public abstract boolean getLoaded();
122
123    /**
124     * Load the config
125     *
126     * @throws IOException On load error
127     * @since 1.0.0
128     */
129    public void load() throws IOException {
130        this.load(false);
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * Load the config
135     *
136     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
137     *
138     * @throws IOException On load error
139     * @since 1.3.0
140     */
141    public abstract void load(boolean save) throws IOException;
142
143    /**
144     * Save the config
145     *
146     * @throws IOException On save error
147     * @since 1.0.0
148     */
149    public abstract void save() throws IOException;
150
151    /**
152     * Close the config
153     *
154     * @throws IOException On close error
155     * @since 1.0.0
156     */
157    public abstract void close() throws IOException;
158
159    /**
160     * Get if the config is closed
161     *
162     * @return If the config is closed
163     *
164     * @since 1.0.0
165     */
166    public abstract boolean isClosed();
167}
